AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Runesmith
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can sense and wield magic in the manner of the dawi, via runes and minor powers. Gifted by the dwarfen gods at birth, [PAWN_pronoun] crafts wonderful things and assists in making life better for all dawi in the hold. [PAWN_possessive] innate abilities combined with studies have crafted [PAWN_objective] into a runesmith.
